page: Routing: flexible and intuitive path matching. HTTP methods: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/all(). Path patterns: static, dynamic :param, optional :param?, regexp :param{pattern}, wildcard *, including slashes. Chaining methods on same path. Grouping routes with route(). Base path prefix. Hostname-based routing. Priority: registration order matters, handlers stop execution. Middleware must come before handlers. Fallback routes at end. Strict mode default true distinguishes /hello and /hello/.

sections.manifest: Basic routing: app.get/post/put/delete/patch/query/all(path, handler). Wildcard /wild/*/card. Custom methods app.on('PURGE'). Multiple methods app.on(['PUT','DELETE']). Multiple paths app.on('GET', [paths]).
Path parameters: app.get('/user/:name', (c) => c.req.param('name')). Get all: c.req.param() returns { name, ... }.
Optional parameters: :param? matches with and without value. app.get('/api/animal/:type?', ...) matches /api/animal and /api/animal/:type.
Including slashes: :filename{.+\.png} for paths containing slashes.
Chained route: app.get(path, (c) => ...).post((c) => ...).delete((c) => ...) handles same path with multiple methods.
Grouping: create Hono instance for routes, add to main app with app.route(path, subapp). Enables modular route organization.
Grouping without changing base: route paths as full paths in subapp, add to main app with app.route('/', subapp). Handles multiple bases.
Base path: app.basePath('/api') prefix all routes. app.get('/book') becomes GET /api/book.
Hostname routing: custom getPath function in constructor. Parse URL hostname with regex to route by domain.
Host header routing: custom getPath function using req.headers.get('host'). Route by host header value, enables User-Agent routing.
Routing priority: handlers execute in registration order. First match stops execution. Middleware before handler, fallback handler at end. Specific routes before generic patterns.
Grouping ordering: route() adds stored routing to current app. Correct order required: subapp routes must be registered before main app.route(). Incorrect order returns 404.
